mapper.delete: delete from sys_ecmwf where ECMWF_TYPE=#{ecmwfType} and data_time != #{dataTime}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `sys_ecmwf` (ecmwf_id, ecmwf_type, ecmwf_path, begin_time, end_time, in_time,data_time, ecmwf_str,begin_lat,begin_lon,grib,longth_num,height_num,end_lat,end_lon,min_data,max_data,grib_unit) VALUES (UUID_SHORT(), #{ecmwfType}, #{ecmwfPath}, #{beginTime}, #{endTime}, NOW(), #{dataTime},#{ecmwfStr},#{beginLat},#{beginLon},#{grib},#{longthNum},#{heightNum},#{endLat},#{endLon},#{minData},#{maxData},#{gribUnit})
mapper.select: SELECT data_time as "gribRefTime", ecmwf_str as "ecmwfStr", begin_lat as lat1, begin_lon as long2, grib as dx, grib as dy, longth_num as nx, height_num as ny, end_lat as lat2, end_lon as long1, min_data as min, max_data as max, grib_unit as "gribUnit" FROM sys_ecmwf WHERE ECMWF_TYPE = #{ecmwfType} and #{queryDate} between BEGIN_TIME and END_TIME order by data_time desc limit 1

SELECT data_time as "gribRefTime", ecmwf_str as "ecmwfStr", begin_lat as lat1, begin_lon as long2, grib as dx, grib as dy, longth_num as nx, height_num as ny, end_lat as lat2, end_lon as long1, min_data as min, max_data as max, grib_unit as "gribUnit" FROM sys_ecmwf WHERE ECMWF_TYPE = #{ecmwfType} order by BEGIN_TIME desc limit 1
